pipelines.name: Build & Test

include.build:
cargo build --target x86_64-apple-darwin --release
cargo build --target aarch64-apple-darwin --release

cargo build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --release
cargo build --target aarch64-pc-windows-msvc --release

steps.name: Run tests
steps.run:
cargo test --release || { echo "Unit tests failed" >&2; exit 1; }

# use the --version arg to ensure that the binary compiles and runs
test_stdout="$(cargo run --quiet --release -- --version)"
exit_code=$?

if [[ $exit_code -eq 0 ]]; then
  echo "Binary execution tests passed"
  echo "Binary version: $test_stdout"
else
  echo "Binary execution tests failed with exit code $exit_code" >&2
  echo "stdout of sm-action --version was: '$test_stdout'" >&2
  exit $exit_code
fi

steps.name: Ensure that `set_env=false` works correctly
steps.run:
echo set_env is false, so secrets should not be in env:
if [ -n "$SECRET_NO_ENV_ONE" ] || [ -n "$SECRET_NO_ENV_TWO" ] || [ -n "$SECRET_NO_ENV_THREE" ]; then
  echo "Secrets found in environment variables, but set_env is false" >&2
  exit 1
else
  echo "No secrets found in environment variables, as expected"
fi
echo

echo printing unmasked secrets with spaces between each character from GITHUB_OUTPUT:
echo "$SECRET_OUTPUT_ONE" | sed 's/./& /g'
echo "$SECRET_OUTPUT_TWO" | sed 's/./& /g'
echo "$SECRET_OUTPUT_THREE" | sed 's/./& /g'
echo

steps.name: Print Output from Rust sm-action
steps.run:
echo the following secrets should be masked:
echo "SECRET_ONE=$SECRET_ONE"
echo "SECRET_TWO=$SECRET_TWO"
echo "SECRET_MULTILINE=$SECRET_MULTILINE"
echo

echo the following should be unmasked secret values with spaces between each character:
echo "$SECRET_ONE" | sed 's/./& /g'
echo "$SECRET_TWO" | sed 's/./& /g'
echo "$SECRET_MULTILINE" | sed 's/./& /g'
echo

steps.name: Print output from TypeScript sm-action@v2.2.0
steps.run:
echo the following secrets should be masked:
echo "SECRET_ONE=$SECRET_ONE"
echo "SECRET_TWO=$SECRET_TWO"
echo "SECRET_MULTILINE=$SECRET_MULTILINE"
echo

echo the following should be unmasked secret values with spaces between each character:
echo "$SECRET_ONE" | sed 's/./& /g'
echo "$SECRET_TWO" | sed 's/./& /g'
echo "$SECRET_MULTILINE" | sed 's/./& /g'
echo

steps.name: Print secret value line-by-line
steps.run:
echo the following multi-line secret should be masked:
echo "$SECRET_VAL" | while IFS= read -r line; do
  echo "LINE: $line"
done

steps.name: Compare GITHUB_OUTPUT values from both actions
steps.run:
if [ "${RUST_SECRET_ONE}" != "${TYPESCRIPT_SECRET_ONE}" ]; then
  echo "SECRET_ONE does not match between sm-action and TypeScript sm-action@v2.2.0" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [ "${RUST_SECRET_TWO}" != "${TYPESCRIPT_SECRET_TWO}" ]; then
  echo "SECRET_TWO does not match between sm-action and TypeScript sm-action@v2.2.0" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [ "${RUST_SECRET_MULTILINE}" != "${TYPESCRIPT_SECRET_MULTILINE}" ]; then
  echo "SECRET_MULTILINE does not match between sm-action and TypeScript sm-action@v2.2.0" >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "All outputs match between sm-action and TypeScript sm-action@v2.2.0"

steps.name: Prepare build artifacts
steps.run:
echo renaming files to:
for target in ${{ join(matrix.targets, ' ') }}; do
  ext=""
  if [[ "$target" == *"windows"* ]]; then
    ext=".exe"
  fi
  mv "target/$target/release/sm-action$ext" "sm-action-$target$ext"
  echo "sm-action-$target$ext"
done

pipelines.name: Version Bump

steps.name: Configure Git
steps.run:
git config --local user.name "$_BOT_NAME"
git config --local user.email "$_BOT_EMAIL"

steps.name: Verify input version
steps.run:
# Error if version has not changed.
if [[ "$NEW_VERSION" == "$CURRENT_VERSION" ]]; then
  echo "Version has not changed."
  exit 1
fi

# Check if version is newer.
if printf '%s\n' "${CURRENT_VERSION}" "${NEW_VERSION}" | sort -C -V; then
  echo "Version check successful."
else
  echo "Version check failed."
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Check if version changed
steps.run:
if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
  echo "changes_to_commit=TRUE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo "changes_to_commit=FALSE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "No changes to commit!";
fi
